To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the visual relationship graph is a useful inductive bias for image captioning, which is constructed with the help of captions, 2) the visual relationship is a useful feature for both the image representation and caption prediction.
We introduce a novel caption guided visual relationship graph to better explore semantics in captions and leverage them to enhance both image and caption representations.

(1) we present a novel framework for image captioning that better utilizes the available semantics in captions, (2) the framework constructs caption guided visual relationship graph, (3) the representation is then enhanced using neighbouring and contextual nodes and their textual and visual information, (4) during generation, the model incorporates visual relationships using a multi task learning setting, and (5) the framework achieves state of the art results on MSCOCO dataset
